sources.title: GitHub - nsdevaraj/autoClient: Standalone AutoDraw web client: sketch ...
sources.snippet: A standalone AutoDraw web client: sketch on the canvas, and the app recognises the drawing in the browser and offers matching icons that replace the sketch. Everything runs locally — the ONNX models, the icon retrieval index and the static server are all in this folder.
